subject: Request: temporary grant of promotional credits for campus research pilot
messages:
From: Dr. Lina Cortez <lina.cortez@hope-scholarship.org>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for temporary promotional credits for campus research pilot

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last week — the students at Northvale Community Campus started their supervised pilot with Redwood models yesterday and the initial runs look promising. We ran into an unexpected surge in token usage while validating several prompt sets for participant consent forms and automated summarization.

We are a nonprofit (Hope Scholarship Foundation) running an IRB-approved pilot; our grant budget is restricted and we rely on partner credits to stretch the research further. Would Redwood consider a one-time promotional credit top-up for the remainder of July (or a trial extension) so we can complete validation and export final evals for our funder?

Highlights: 
- Pilot: 6 student cohorts, text summarization + classification experiments
- Current account: hsf-northvale (self-serve PLG signup last month)
- Ask: up to 75k token-equivalent credits or a 30-day extension of the existing free trial (whichever is standard)

Attached is our short proposal and IRB cover page for context. Happy to provide any additional paperwork.

Best,
Lina Cortez
Director of Research Programs
Hope Scholarship Foundation
Attachment: HopeSchol-Research-Proposal.pdf

Hi Lina — thanks for the note and for sending the proposal. Really glad the pilot is off to a promising start.

Quick Qs to help me route this:
- Can you confirm the account id shown in your console (I think you mentioned hsf-northvale)?
- Are you registered as a 501(c)(3) in the US? (I only need the short confirmation, we'll handle verification)
- Do you have a specific timeline when the extra tokens need to be available? You mentioned the end of July.

I copied Marcus (partnerships) so he can see the research brief. Our usual path is to validate nonprofit status + confirm token request, then Marcus or I route for a promotional approval. If this is time-sensitive we can expedite.

Next steps I’ll take after your reply: 
1) Verify account and nonprofit status
2) Internal promo approval request (I’ll loop in Dev if a deviation from standard credits is required)
3) Issue credits and send details + terms

— Evelyn Hart
Customer Growth, Redwood Inference
